title: UI: keyboard shortcuts Ctrl+D (duplicate), Shift+F5 (remove frame), Shift+F6 (clear keyframe)
description:
Add three missing keyboard shortcuts. Files: packages/authoring-ui/src/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts and packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx.

1. Ctrl+D — duplicate selection (Flash 8 canonical shortcut):
   - Add onDuplicate?: () => void to KeyboardShortcutHandlers interface in useKeyboardShortcuts.ts
   - Add binding: else if (ctrl && !shift && e.key === 'd') { e.preventDefault(); h.onDuplicate?.(); }
   - Wire in Shell.tsx useKeyboardShortcuts call: onDuplicate: handleDuplicate (the handleDuplicate function already exists in Shell.tsx around line 1617)

2. Shift+F5 — remove frame:
   - Add onRemoveFrame?: () => void to KeyboardShortcutHandlers (if it doesn't exist already)
   - Add binding: else if (shift && e.key === 'F5') { e.preventDefault(); h.onRemoveFrame?.(); }
   - Wire in Shell.tsx: onRemoveFrame: handleRemoveFrame (find the existing handleRemoveFrame function)

3. Shift+F6 — clear keyframe (convert keyframe back to regular frame):
   - Add onClearKeyframe?: () => void to KeyboardShortcutHandlers (if it doesn't exist already)
   - Add binding: else if (shift && e.key === 'F6') { e.preventDefault(); h.onClearKeyframe?.(); }
   - Wire in Shell.tsx: onClearKeyframe: handleClearKeyframe (find the existing handler)

Read useKeyboardShortcuts.ts and Shell.tsx carefully before editing to find the exact existing patterns and ensure you match the code style.

Run: pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run (must stay at 612)
